stem: A client with asthma uses a peak-flow meter and obtains a reading that is 45% of the client's personal-best peak flow. According to the CDC Asthma Action Plan, how should the nurse interpret this finding?

options.A: The reading is in the red-zone medical-alert range, so the client should follow the individualized red-zone actions and contact the clinician as directed.
options.B: The reading is in the green zone because peak flow above 40% of personal best indicates adequate control when the client feels comfortable.
options.C: The reading is in the yellow zone because values from roughly 40% through 80% of personal best are managed with the same action-plan instructions.
options.D: The peak-flow percentage does not determine an action-plan zone, so it can be disregarded when the client has no current respiratory symptoms.

rationale: CDC's May 4, 2026 asthma guidance states that the red-zone medical-alert criterion includes a peak-flow reading less than half of personal best. The yellow zone is approximately half to three quarters of personal best, and the green zone is more than 80% of personal best. Therefore 45% is in the red zone. The client should follow the individualized red-zone medication/contact instructions and seek hospital care if symptoms do not improve and the clinician cannot be reached. A is correct.
educational_objective: Use percentage of personal-best peak expiratory flow to identify the CDC asthma-action-plan red zone and respond according to the individualized plan.
source_organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
source_document_title: Living with Asthma — Asthma Action Plans
source_locator: Asthma Action Plans: Green Zone — peak flow >80% of best; Yellow Zone — half to about three quarters of best; Red Zone — peak flow less than half of best, add prescribed medicines/call clinician and go to hospital if not improving and clinician cannot be reached.
source_claim_supported: A peak flow of 45% of personal best is below half of best and therefore falls in the CDC red-zone medical-alert range.
blueprint_locator: Reduction of Risk Potential — monitor response to treatment and recognize trends/changes in condition.
correction_summary: Balanced option lengths and maintained parallel action-plan-zone interpretations while preserving the CDC red-zone threshold.

audit_findings.independent_adversarial_second_pass: PASS — current CDC guidance explicitly defines red zone as less than half of personal best; 45% is unambiguously red-zone.
